title: Reefer Cargo Services: Uniform Carrying Instructions Across a Booking
content:
Under Reefer Cargo Services the reefer services attached to one booking are treated as a set. A booking moves a single commodity under a single set of carriage instructions, and the services on it therefore have to agree with one another.

## Clause

All live services on one booking, meaning every service on it that has not been cancelled, must share the same tier, the same commodity and the same set point. An order for an additional service on the booking, or an alteration of the settings of a service on it, is refused if it would leave the live services of that booking differing in any of these three particulars. A customer who wants one of these particulars altered on a booking therefore has it altered for every service on the booking together, and the alteration is entered separately on each of those services. The test is made against the line's records of the booking's services as they stand before the order or alteration is actioned.

## Particulars compared

| Particular | Must match across the booking's live services |
|---|---|
| Tier | yes |
| Commodity | yes |
| Set point | yes |

The comparison covers those three particulars only; this clause is silent on the other carrying settings.

## Truth table for an additional order

| Booking's live services at the time of the order | New order's tier, commodity and set point | Outcome under this clause |
|---|---|---|
| none | any | no comparison arises |
| one or more | identical to theirs in all three | not refused under this clause |
| one or more | different in at least one | refused |

## Hypothetical cases

- A booking has three live services of fresh table grapes on the same tier at -0.5 °C. A fourth order for the same commodity and tier at 0.0 °C would break the match on set point and is refused.
- On the same booking the customer instructs a new set point of 0.0 °C for all three containers at once. The booking stays uniform, and the alteration is entered three times, once on each service.
- An instruction to alter the set point of just one of the three services would leave the booking mixed and is refused.
- One of the booking's services is cancelled. It drops out of the comparison, since only live services are compared.
